players.name: James Conner
players.summary: Conner (foot) isn't yet doing full-team drills at training camp, Darren Urban of azcardinals.com reports.

players.name: Tip Reiman
players.summary: Reiman (ankle) was placed on the active/PUP list Thursday, Darren Urban of the Cardinals' official site reports.

players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
players.summary: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Friday that Atlanta's starters will likely see action in the team's first and third preseason games, but it remains to be seen whether Penix (knee) will be ready to take the field by then, Tori McElhaney of the Falcons' official site reports.

players.name: Tua Tagovailoa
players.summary: Tagovailoa (back) did not take part in team drills Friday due to a "precautionary thing" related to back tightness and said he is unsure when he will be fully cleared for on-field activities, Marc Raimondi of ESPN reports.

players.name: Tyrell Shavers
players.summary: The Bills placed Shavers (knee) on the active/PUP list Tuesday, Matt Parrino of The Syracuse Post-Standard reports.

players.name: Chris Brazzell II
players.summary: The Panthers placed Brazzell (knee) on injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Dan Chisena
players.summary: The Panthers placed Chisena (undisclosed) on injured reserve Wednesday, Darin Gantt of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Mitchell Evans
players.summary: Evans has been diagnosed with a low ankle sprain and is considered day-to-day, Sheena Quick of Fox Sports Radio 1340 reports.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.summary: Monangai was absent from Friday's practice due to an undisclosed reason, Patrick Finley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

players.name: Josh Kattus
players.summary: The Bengals placed Kattus (undisclosed) on the active/non-football injury list Saturday.

players.name: Joseph Manjack IV
players.summary: Manjack (back) could return to practice as early as Monday, NFL reporter Jordan Schultz reports.

players.name: Caleb Lohner
players.summary: Lohner is expected to miss two weeks after undergoing a lower-body procedure, Mike Klis of 9News Denver reports.

players.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
players.summary: Lions coach Dan Campbell said Thursday that he's "not even sweating" Gibbs' absence from training camp amidst contract negotiations, though Campbell also noted that the running back is dealing with minor back discomfort, ESPN.com's Eric Woodyard reports.

players.name: Tyler Conklin
players.summary: The Lions placed Conklin (knee) on the active/PUP list Sunday.

players.name: Kendrick Law
players.summary: The Lions placed Law (knee) on the reserve/injured list Wednesday.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.summary: Kraft (knee), who was activated from the active/PUP list Friday, took part in individual drills at his first practice of Packers training camp, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Chris Brooks
players.summary: Brooks is on the Packers' active/non-football injury list during training camp due to a hamstring injury, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Luke Musgrave
players.summary: Packers GM Brian Gutekunst said Wednesday that Musgrave was placed on the active/PUP list due to a neck injury and that the team is working to diagnose whether the tight end is facing a long-term issue, Tom Silverstein of the Milwaukee Journal Sentinel reports.

players.name: Jaylin Noel
players.summary: Noel's placement on the active/non-football injury list is due to a finger injury that could cause him to miss a few weeks, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Tank Dell
players.summary: Dell (knee) will be held out of full-team reps to open training camp, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.summary: Colts GM Chris Ballard said Tuesday that Pierce (ankle) is a "week or so away" from practicing, Mike Chappell of Fox 59 News Indianapolis reports.

players.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
players.summary: Rodriguez (foot) has been cleared to practice, but the Jaguars intend to take a cautious approach with the running back's participation level early in training camp, John Shipley of SI.com reports.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.summary: Worthy is believed to avoided a serious shoulder injury that he sustained during the final session of Saturday's training camp practice, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

players.name: Cyrus Allen
players.summary: Allen was diagnosed with a shin bruise on his left leg that he suffered during Saturday's training camp practice, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes
players.summary: Mahomes (knee) is participating in 11-on-11 team drills during Wednesday's training camp practice, Matt McMullen of the Chiefs' official site reports.

players.name: John Michael Gyllenborg
players.summary: The Chiefs placed Gyllenborg (knee) on injured reserve Tuesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

players.name: Corey Rucker
players.summary: Rucker (undisclosed) was placed on the reserve/injured list Wednesday.

players.name: Justin Shorter
players.summary: Shorter (undisclosed) was placed on the reserve/injured list by the Raiders on Monday.

players.name: Chris Bell
players.summary: The Dolphins placed Bell (ACL) on the active/non-football injury list Tuesday.

players.name: Kejon Owens
players.summary: Owens was placed on the active/non-football illness list by the Vikings on Monday.

players.name: Jimmy Kibble
players.summary: Kibble (undisclosed) reverted to New England's injured reserve Friday.

players.name: Jeremiah Webb
players.summary: The Patriots placed Webb (arm) on injured reserve Sunday, Evan Lazar of the team's official site reports.

players.name: CJ Dippre
players.summary: Dippre (undisclosed) will be on the active/PUP list to start training camp, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Terrell Jennings
players.summary: Jennings will open up training camp on the active/non-football injury list, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Mason Tipton
players.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Wednesday that Tipton is still recovering from offseason tibia surgery, Mike Triplett of NewOrleans.Football reports.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.summary: Nabers (knee) said Thursday that he "felt great" after practicing Wednesday for the first time since having his torn ACL surgically repaired in October, Matt Citak of the Giants' official site reports.

players.name: Beaux Collins
players.summary: Collins (concussion) was spotted working with trainers on the side at practice Monday, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Gunner Olszewski
players.summary: Olszewski (Achilles) was placed on injured reserve by the Giants on Monday, Dan Salomone of the team's official site reports.

players.name: Gee Scott Jr.
players.summary: Scott (undisclosed) reverted to the Jets' injured reserve Saturday, per the NFL's transaction log.

players.name: Jalen Walthall
players.summary: Walthall (undisclosed) reverted to the Jets' injured reserve Friday after clearing waivers, per the NFL's transaction report.

players.name: Tanner McLachlan
players.summary: McLachlan (undisclosed) reverted to the 49ers' injured reserve Saturday, per the NFL's transaction log.

players.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
players.summary: Stribling will not participate in Saturday's training camp practice due to hamstring tightness, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.summary: Pearsall was placed on injured reserve Saturday and will undergo season-ending PCL surgery on his right knee, Cam Inman of The San Jose Mercury News reports.

players.name: Jordan James
players.summary: James fractured a rib during Tuesday's practice, Vic Tafur of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Christian Kirk
players.summary: Kirk sustained a calf injury during Sunday's practice and is not practicing Monday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

players.name: Jake Bobo
players.summary: Bobo did not participate in Tuesday's training camp practice due to a leg injury, Gregg Bell of The Tacoma News Tribune reports.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.summary: The Seahawks have placed Charbonnet (knee) on the physically unable to perform list ahead of training camp, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

players.name: John Bates
players.summary: Bates will miss "a couple of weeks" due to a hamstring injury, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.

players.name: Treylon Burks
players.summary: Burks missed Thursday's practice with foot soreness, Ben Standig of Big 100 Washington D.C. reports.
